description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver and convert Oracle BLOB storage to PostgreSQL bytea.
tasks.reason: The application currently relies on Oracle-specific JDBC, Hibernate, and BLOB configurations and plaintext database credentials. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service, with Managed Identity as the planned authentication method.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and the Hibernate dialect for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle-specific SQL in repositories to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents and update schema definitions, including converting photo BLOB storage to PostgreSQL bytea. Configure the application to connect to Azure Database for PostgreSQL and use Managed Identity authentication instead of plaintext database credentials.
